phases.description: IRIS stands still across the table; HAL looks down at the key on the table
HAL raises his eyes to IRIS
IRIS holds his look and does not answer yet

questions.question: Viewer reads: she has brought the key back - carried by: IRIS, brass key
0-2.5s SETUP: does this happen on screen - IRIS stands still across the table; HAL looks down at the key on the table?
2.5-3.3s ACTION: does this happen on screen - HAL raises his eyes to IRIS?
3.3-6s ACTION: does this happen on screen - HAL speaks to IRIS?
6-8s HOLD: does this happen on screen - IRIS holds his look and does not answer yet?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): HAL speaks to IRIS
HAL: does the face/body read as dry, guarded (restrained)? Must NOT read as: anger.
Line 15 is audible, spoken by the right character, lips match: HAL: You could have posted it.
HAL sounds like the voice bible: low gravelly male voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size WIDE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC01_g1: Continues from the previous shot: IRIS standing across the table, frame-left; HAL seated at the table, frame-right; the key: flat on the table in front of the empty chair; the mugs: two white mugs on the table, the second one steaming beside the key; the empty chair: pulled out from the table on the left.

Last frame matches state SC01_g2: Continues from the previous shot: IRIS standing across the table, frame-left; HAL seated at the table, frame-right; the key: flat on the table in front of the empty chair; the mugs: two white mugs on the table, the second one steaming beside the key; the empty chair: pulled out from the table on the left.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Line 15: does HAL clearly speak to IRIS (eyes and body toward them)?
Is IRIS in frame for the whole clip?
Does HAL look at IRIS and never into the lens?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look. Questions with an id (REL_*) need a short answer in the group check's answers{id: text}; without it the take cannot be ACCEPTED.
